bootstrap.method: resample whole players with replacement within each class x fixed draft-capital bin; preserve each class's observed bin counts; recompute class score and excess ratio

position_preserving_null.method: secondary null preserving position plus broad NFL draft-capital bin when feasible

decision_policy.reason: B12/B13 V2 is a post-V1 architecture and cannot by itself justify production.

outcome.definition: Exact frozen B5/B6 H3.O2 three-season player-equivalent FV outcome.
outcome.name: H3.O2
outcome.provider: Frozen Sleeper historical weekly NFL stats lineage already used by V1.

report: all-gate power at each effect SD

primary_class_score.expected_class_total: sum the leave-one-class-out expected H3.O2 values for every fixed cohort player in that class

expected_player_value.method: leave-one-class-out arithmetic mean H3.O2 within the player's fixed 10-pick NFL draft-capital bin
expected_player_value.reason: H3.O2 is already position-weighted/replacement-adjusted; avoiding position x bin sparsity preserves power.

primary_class_score.observed_class_total: sum H3.O2 for every fixed cohort player in that class
primary_class_score.primary_observed_statistic: sample variance across the 10 class_log_strength values
primary_class_score.purpose: Measure realized class quality relative to the amount and location of NFL top-60 draft capital invested in fantasy skill positions.

algorithm: Keep each class's exact number of cohort slots in every frozen 10-pick draft-capital bin.
Within each draft-capital bin, randomly permute the observed H3.O2 values across the fixed class/bin slots.
Recompute LOO expected totals, class log strengths, and the sample variance for each permutation.
primary_null.name: draft-capital-bin-preserving class-label permutation
primary_null.null_mean_variance: arithmetic mean of the 50,000 null sample variances

post_hoc_architecture_reason: V1 fixed-48 design was blocked by historical Sleeper identity coverage concentrated in 2010-2013.
User froze further identity-recovery effort to NFL top-60 picks.
B11 found no independent Sleeper-ID chain for the six unresolved top-60 retirees.
V2 therefore uses the stable-provider era 2014-2023 and a top-60 NFL-draft-capital population.
